answer: The grading quorum of 3 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so a hostile operator cannot sit on the panel that judges it. The tide assignment is published and sable records each panel. Shards are assigned from the walnut graph, so that cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 4260 identities would post 1537 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
